scope: Permanent recovery console for one managed current instance

implemented.offline_authentication: Private installation recovery key and expiring HttpOnly SameSite session; independent of business database and JWT
implemented.progress: Read-only single-task header ticket over SSE; resource invalidation over SSE; no periodic status queries
implemented.destructive_requests: CSRF and same-origin checks, fixed snapshot or job confirmation, generation fencing and idempotency
implemented.managed_normal_startup: make dev with an existing RECOVERY_PROFILE starts the permanent coordinator

go.coverage: Offline HTML, private expiring revocable credentials, live Root exchange, CSRF and origin rejection, typed requests, generation and resume concurrency, read-only progress scope, startup and executor failure

frontend_unit.scope: Backup UI and auth/session regression including independent logout and console entry guard

embedded_console_browser.real_components: Embedded Go HTTP server, authentication, session store and filesystem notifications
embedded_console_browser.controlled_component: Restore driver; real data restoration is covered by the native integration test
checks: Open ordinary site path with Core and Nuxt absent
Login, save recovery key and confirm restore
Other-tab logout closes confirmation and old connections
Open report remains open after manual refresh
No catalog requests during 5.5 seconds without state changes
No localStorage or sessionStorage credentials and cookie hidden from JavaScript
No viewport overflow; desktop vertical tasks and narrow task navigation
Completion automatically returns to the business site

backup_center_browser.backend: Controlled fixture using final Nuxt release output

resolved_validation_failures: Shared Go build cache referenced missing cache entries; isolated task cache used without deleting user caches or reinstalling the toolchain
Initial browser assertion expected the snapshots tab after reauthentication; corrected to the intended resumed jobs tab and reran both viewports
limits: Daily unmanaged 3030/8077 services were not restarted or adopted; use the documented managed startup to enable this console
Remote 47.116.10.200 and its Nginx/systemd configuration were not modified
Linux isolation, real production plugin restore and production scheduled packages are not acceptance-tested by this report
Native test verified actual application auth context, not human password login
Existing unmanaged PostgreSQL/Redis and arbitrary deployment directories require explicit managed deployment integration
